start_here: Say to your AI: "Cancel my Codex run codex-<id>." It ends that run if it is still running and says whether it did.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it ends one running Codex process group on this computer and reads back the state.
instructions: 1. Give the run id the start row answered.
2. Cancel only when you ask; a run that already ended answers cancelled false and changes nothing.
3. Read the state it answers; cancelled means the run's process group was ended and the state reads back cancelled.
